Container.Name: Bernard
Container.Overview:
Bernard is a self-hosted Discord bot and admin dashboard for one private server. Moderation commands with numbered mod cases and temporary bans, six kinds of server logs, join-to-create voice channels, tenure and activity tracking with automatic tier roles, and a custom permission system. Bot, API and web dashboard run in a single process, and everything lives in one SQLite database under /data.
Before installing, create an application in the Discord Developer Portal: copy the Application ID, bot token and OAuth2 client secret below, enable the Server Members and Message Content intents, and add [Public URL]/api/auth/callback as an OAuth2 redirect. The README has the full setup and the bot invite link.
The container runs as UID 1000, so the Data folder must be writable by it. Before the first start, run on the Unraid terminal: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/bernard && chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/bernard

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web dashboard, e.g. http://tower:3000.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database (bernard.db). Must be writable by UID 1000 (chown -R 1000:1000 on this folder). SQLite should not go through Unraid's user-share (FUSE) layer: keep this share on a pool with Exclusive access, or use the pool path directly (e.g. /mnt/cache/appdata/bernard).

Config.Name: Discord bot token
Config.Description: Developer Portal → your application → Bot → Reset Token.

Config.Name: Discord application ID
Config.Description: Developer Portal → General Information → Application ID.

Config.Name: Server ID
Config.Description: The one Discord server this bot serves. Turn on Developer Mode in Discord (Settings → Advanced), then right-click your server → Copy Server ID.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address people use to open the dashboard, with no trailing slash (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3000 or https://bot.example.com). Add this URL followed by /api/auth/callback as a redirect under OAuth2 in the Developer Portal; it must match exactly or login fails.

Config.Name: Discord client secret
Config.Description: Developer Portal → OAuth2 → Client Secret. Required for the dashboard (Discord login).

Config.Name: Session secret
Config.Description: Random string of at least 32 characters that signs dashboard sessions. Generate one on the Unraid terminal with: openssl rand -hex 32. Required for the dashboard.

Config.Name: Dashboard enabled
Config.Description: Set to false to run only the bot, without the web dashboard. The client secret and session secret are then not needed.

Config.Name: Trusted reverse proxy
Config.Description: Only if a reverse proxy sits in front of the dashboard: the number of proxy hops (1 for Nginx Proxy Manager, 2 for Cloudflare plus Nginx Proxy Manager), or the proxy IP address(es)/CIDR ranges, comma-separated. Leave false otherwise.

Config.Name: Session lifetime (hours)
Config.Description: How long a dashboard login lasts, in hours (default 168 = 7 days, max 2160).
